args.text: Can you pull every ticket and feature request on Pellucid Harbor Logistics and Driftmoor Marine Freight from the Coastal channels and Moss's Coastal notes, labelled by account? Leave Pellow Home Living out even though it shares the PHL code. I need the list for Kwame's account review.

Bettina, here's the list for Kwame's review, from #coastal-team, #coastal-random, Moss's Coastal digests and your Pellucid cutover note. Pellow Home Living / Covey & Lark is left out.

PELLUCID HARBOR LOGISTICS (PHL, Gulf Coast)
- Ticket #4419: Yard_Dwell_Summary report times out when filtered by container length. Open. Source: Moss's Coastal cheat sheet.
- Ticket #PD-8841: chassis pool holds on double-booked gates, Gate 4B. Source: your 2025-12-08 cutover recap.
- No ticket number: chassis pool validation friction at Gate 4 during shift change (Moss's cheat sheet).
- No ticket number: CSV import bug on the Berth 2 yard map, as of the Dec 2025 cutover (your recap). I can't tell whether it was ever fixed.

DRIFTMOOR MARINE FREIGHT (DMF, Puget Sound)
- Feature request #882: bulk-clear button for departed barges, requested by their warehouse managers. Source: Moss's cheat sheet.
- Ticket #4419 again: Moss's 2025-11-02 digest lists it as a barge slip 7 schedule sync issue. See the note below.
- No ticket number: tide-table import macro failed on Terminal B. Engineering gave a manual CSV patch for the night dispatcher (cheat sheet).
- No ticket number: DMF asked for a patched manifest CSV before the 06:00 shift (2025-11-02 digest).

Please check two things:
- #4419 is attached to PHL in one Moss note and DMF in another. I couldn't tell which is right, so I listed it under both. Kwame should confirm.
- Most of this is from late 2025, and I found no status updates on any of it. #coastal-team and #coastal-random show nothing newer on either account. The ticket system itself isn't visible to me.

I left out #8812, PD-4821, PD-4824 and PD-4827. They belong to Pellow Home Living or Saltmarsh Provisions.
